title: On a person's channel row, a quiet line that mentions them lights the @ and moves the row, without counting
why: #proj-raft-ui:#319 (Kirby 71732dab): a personal mention is activity for the person even on a quiet line, so it moves the row as on a task row. Its kind does not count as unread for people.
